name: Open-M3-Bench
description:
M3-Bench Image Assets
	

This dataset contains the image assets for M3-Bench: Multi-Modal, Multi-Hop, Multi-Threaded Tool-Using MLLM Agent Benchmark, a benchmark for multimodal tool use under the Model Context Protocol (MCP). M3-Bench targets realistic workflows where an agent must jointly reason over images, text, and MCP tools in multi-hop and sometimes multi-threaded trajectories.
For full details, please see the paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.17729.

	
		
	
	
		Contents… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/EtaYang10th/Open-M3-Bench.
reputation: Newly introduced benchmark for multimodal tool-using agents; gaining attention in the multimodal agent evaluation community but not yet widely adopted.
